readings.Aries: The right thing to do right now involves not doing anything. That's harder for you than most. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Taurus: You've earned the comfort you're defending. You're also allowed to want something beyond it. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: Your mind is faster than your life. This is both your gift and your primary source of boredom. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Cancer: Someone needs your care. You need rest. Both things are true simultaneously. Let this one be easy.
readings.Leo: The recognition you crave is available in the form of self-recognition. It lasts longer. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Virgo: Your threshold for mess — physical, emotional, relational — is low. Today something messy is unavoidable. Let this one be easy.
readings.Libra: You've agreed to something that was wrong for you in the moment of agreeing. You can revisit it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Scorpio: Something is ending that you don't want to end. Your resistance is understandable and will not stop it. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Sagittarius: You've outgrown something. The exit is available. Give it a moment of ceremony. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Capricorn: There is a shortcut available. You won't take it on principle. Make sure the principle is worth it. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Aquarius: There is a feeling underneath the analysis that the analysis is a way of not feeling. Set the analysis down briefly. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Pisces: Your sensitivity to what is unsaid is acute. Today what is unsaid needs to be said by you. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
